description:
## [1.3.1](https://github.com/suakamargas121/shiny-train/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) (2026-09-09)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* integrity helper b() is PUBLIC FINAL — fingerprint missed FINAL flag ([ae43f46](https://github.com/suakamargas121/shiny-train/commit/ae43f46f296f956fa085fdd6d0fa40240c1beab9))

patches.name: Android 10 compatibility (minSdk 29)
patches.description: Lowers minSdkVersion to 29 so the patched app installs on Android 10 and 11. All newer-API calls in the app are version-guarded.

patches.name: Bypass Play Integrity token (keep attestation)
patches.description: Replaces the Play Integrity token with an empty one during device attestation. The attestation, PoP signing and token refresh keep working; the server accepts an empty integrity token.

patches.name: Bypass Play Store redirect
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license check entirely (initial + repeated checks and the trial path) so a sideloaded or patched build is never flagged, and no Play Store redirect or shutdown happens.

patches.name: Bypass device attestation
patches.description: Skips device attestation entirely. The server rejects sessions without attestation — use 'Bypass Play Integrity token' instead.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics and FCM
patches.description: Disables Google Firebase Analytics tracking and removes Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications.

patches.name: Neuter Telegram security breach reporter
patches.description: Stops the app from reporting security breaches or APK integrity failures to the developers' Telegram channel.

patches.name: Remove certificate pinning
patches.description: Removes the hard-coded OkHttp certificate pins and SSL pinning interceptor so the app trusts system and user CAs.

patches.name: Remove screenshot restriction
patches.description: Disables the FLAG_SECURE window flag in the PDF and EPUB readers so screenshots and screen recordings are allowed.

patches.name: Save book to Downloads
patches.description: Adds a menu option that downloads, decrypts, and saves the book as a readable PDF or EPUB in the public Downloads folder.
